title: Beetle God Ritual
description: A large multi-armed beetle deity with a golden stacked crown stands behind an altar, holding a staff. Five hooded cultists kneel in worship as red liquid drips from a central offering covered in eyes and jewels, set against a dark abstract background with swirling white patterns and glowing orbs.
prompt: A towering multi-armed scarab beetle god wearing a tall ornate golden crown stands behind a ritual altar, holding a staff in one hand. Five robed cultists with spider symbols on their backs kneel in reverence. The altar is covered in eyes and jewels with red liquid dripping down. Dark surreal background with white swirling smoke, glowing orbs and abstract ink splatters, high contrast black and white illustration with gold and red accents
